subject: Close sprint: sequencing MSA/DPA/order-form and evaluation gating
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@synapsetx.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Synapse Procurement <procurement@synapsetx.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan + legal sequencing for Synapse POC

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to pull together an explicit close plan that ties the evaluation milestones to the contracting path (MSA, DPA, order form). Can you send a mutual action plan (MAP) that shows:

- Who signs what and when (MSA owner, DPA owner, PO/order form)
- Evaluation gating criteria we need to satisfy before signatures
- Any blockers from your side (SLA, data residency, audit evidence)
- A proposed target close date (we're aiming for the end of Q2)

We want clarity because our legal team will only start the MSA review once procurement confirms the evaluation acceptance criteria.

Appreciate a single-sheet MAP and a short note on sequencing. If you can include tentative dates for signature and DocuSign routing, that would help us sync internal calendars.

Best,
Olivia
Director, Vendor Ops
Synapse Therapeutics

[Attachment: Synapse-Eval-Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@synapsetx.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan + legal sequencing for Synapse POC

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the note and the clear ask. I can take point on a one-page MAP and sequence. Quick clarifying Qs so we align the gating:

1) Evaluation acceptance — do you need performance (latency/throughput) and qualitative accuracy checks, or is a feature/UX checklist sufficient for the pilot?
2) For the DPA, is Synapse expecting standard EU-model clauses or any additional HIPAA / PHI constraints?
3) Are there internal signers for the PO vs order form (procurement vs business lead)?

I'll draft the MAP and a proposed signature schedule. I'll loop in Karthik (legal contact) for MSA/DPA redline questions; Marissa will help with order form pricing and lead time. Expect a first draft by Monday EOD.

Hannah
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation plan + legal sequencing for Synapse POC

Team — forwarding Olivia's ask. High-level plan I propose:

- Week 1 (Mar 12-16): Redwood delivers MAP + evaluation gating matrix; Synapse confirms acceptance criteria.
- Week 2 (Mar 19-23): Synapse procurement shares PO owner; Redwood shares MSA (clean) + DPA extract; legal begins parallel review.
- Week 3 (Mar 26-30): MSA redline round 1 (legal), DPA questions resolved.
- Week 4 (Apr 2-6): Order form finalization; pricing signoff; DocuSign routing.

Dependencies / blockers: specific DPA clauses (PHI/HIPAA) could add two weeks; SOC2 evidence is already public but we may need an AO to provide architecture diagrams.

Action items: Karthik — can you provide a quick list of MSA hotspots to expect (IP, indemnity, data residency)? Marissa — prep a draft order form with the POC pricing and an estimated invoice schedule. Laura — help me confirm internal SLA language that we can offer for POC.

I'll draft the MAP and attach it Monday.

Thanks,
Hannah

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@synapsetx.com>, Derek Huang <derek.huang@synapsetx.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood MAP + sequencing (synapse POC) — draft attached

Hi Olivia / Derek —

Attached is our proposed MAP and sequencing spreadsheet (Redwood-MAP-v1.0.xlsx) and a short extract of the MSA redline with the items we typically see cause delay. Summary below:

- Evaluation gating: performance baseline (99th p50 latency under 300ms on 8k seq), sample pass/fail checks (5 canonical prompts), security checklist (SOC2+KMS integration).
- Sequencing: legal review of MSA/DPA starts once Synapse confirms evaluation acceptance criteria. We will run MSA/DPA review in parallel with order form pricing (we recommend parallel to shorten calendar).
- Proposed target: signature routing starts Apr 5 with aim to have fully executed MSA + DPA + order form by Apr 16 (assuming one redline round).

Key dependencies: confirmation on PHI handling needed — if PHI scope is included we estimate +10 business days for DPA and compliance signoffs.

Next steps: please confirm evaluation acceptance criteria by Thur, Mar 15 so legal can begin review on Mar 19. I've included a DocuSign placeholder in related links; we'll only create the envelope once redlines settle.

Attachments:
- Redwood-MAP-v1.0.xlsx (MAP + gating matrix)
- MSA-draft-Redwood-redline.pdf (MSA extract with hotspots)
- DPA-extract-summary.docx (short summary of typical DPA asks)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute sync if useful.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Derek Huang <derek.huang@synapsetx.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@synapsetx.com>, Synapse Procurement <procurement@synapsetx.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP + sequencing (synapse POC) — draft attached

Hannah —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the MAP. A couple of constraints from procurement/legal that affect sequencing:

1) We need evaluation acceptance confirmed by our clinical ops lead before procurement will approve starting MSA review. That adds an internal handoff (2 business days for signoff).
2) If PII/PHI is in scope, DPA routing is required to security committee and that adds +8-10 business days.
3) We prefer to sign order forms after MSA is executed, not in parallel — procurement policy.

Given the constraints, our realistic timeline looks like: signoff on evaluation gating by Mar 17, MSA review start Mar 20, DPA parallel only if PHI confirmed; target MSA execution Apr 20, order form sign Apr 27.

If Redwood can commit to the evaluation acceptance deadline (Mar 17) and provide the SOC2 evidence and the KMS diagram by end of day Wed (Mar 14), we will prioritize the legal review. Otherwise the timeline slips.

I'll schedule a quick internal call to confirm the clinical ops approver and will loop back.

Thanks,
Derek Huang
Senior Procurement Manager, Synapse Therapeutics
[Attachment: none]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Derek Huang <derek.huang@synapsetx.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@synapsetx.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MAP + sequencing (synapse POC) — confirmed next steps

Derek / Olivia —

Thanks — clear and helpful. We will: 

- Confirm evaluation acceptance criteria by Fri, Mar 17 (Hannah / Synapse clinical ops)
- Share SOC2 report link and KMS diagram by EOD Wed, Mar 14 (I've asked Security to push the AO package)
- Karthik will prepare a short note on likely MSA hotspots for your GC to speed review (expect by Mar 16)
- Marissa will hold order form pricing in reserve until execution, but will prepare a clean order form so it can be routed within 2 business days of MSA execution.

If PHI becomes confirmed in scope, we will flag it immediately and provide an updated MAP with an adjusted timeline.

I'll follow up Friday with the MAP v1.1 if there are any small edits based on clinical ops feedback. For now, I'll mark the proposed target as: MSA execution Apr 20, order form Apr 27, with the caveat that PHI / DPA routing could extend dates.

If it helps, we can do a 20-min sync Thu morning to confirm the acceptance checklist — let me know preferred times.

Regards,
Hannah
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
